issues.detail: The Greek 'το σωτηρι μου' (my savior) is rendered as 'Đấng Cứu Thế của tôi' (my Savior). In the context of this verse (Psalm 16:11), 'σωτήρ' refers to 'deliverer' or 'salvation.' While 'Cứu Thế' is a common title, it implies a cosmic role (Savior of the world) rather than the personal act of deliverance/salvation expressed in the Greek.
